caption: The drawing depicts a teapot with a rounded, bulbous body and an ornate, curved spout on the left side. The handle on the right side is large, thick, and highlighted in dark shading, and it has a decorative flourish at the top and base where it connects to the teapot. The lid is topped with a faceted knob and features a slightly raised, curved rim. Decorative floral engravings encircle the upper portion of the teapot’s body. The teapot stands on a rounded, tiered base. The drawing is done in grayscale, using shading to provide depth and highlight the roundness and metallic texture of the object. In the bottom left corner, there is a smaller detailed drawing of a different object, resembling a handle or finial, also rendered in grayscale, showing a similarly ornate style with scrollwork at the base and a darkly shaded upper portion. The drawing is centered on a plain, unadorned background with a simple border outline.
title: Silver Teapot
